title: Anthus organizations take a release before any customer does
description:
**Phase 4 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the release record story
- **Runs in parallel with:** the update and notification stories
- **Unblocks:** nothing

---
The release gate, and the thing that makes the marketing claim true rather than aspirational.

The promise on the page is that Anthus keeps customer deployments updated as it updates the organizations it runs itself. **That is credible exactly as long as it is literally the order things happen in.** A release reaching a customer before it has run in an Anthus organization is not a scheduling detail, it is the claim being false.

So the rollout refuses to advance. Not warns — refuses. A gate that can be overridden under deadline pressure is not a gate, and the pressure to ship a fix straight to a customer is highest on exactly the release most likely to break something.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

comments.text:
Feature: Managed updates

  Scenario: A release reaches Anthus organizations first
    Given a new Chatticus release
    When the rollout begins
    Then Anthus organizations receive it before any customer organization

  Scenario: A release that has not run at Anthus cannot reach a customer
    Given a new Chatticus release that no Anthus organization is running
    When a rollout to a customer organization is attempted
    Then it is refused
    And the customer organization keeps its current release
